title: asmsense-data: training and evaluation data for naming functions in stripped x86-64 binaries
description: Chat-format training, validation and test data for asmsense, a small language model that names and describes functions in stripped x86-64 binaries. Inputs are anonymized assembly (Mach-O, clang, -O0 to -Os), call context and, from v6, Ghidra decompilation; targets are the original function name plus one-sentence English and Turkish descriptions. The split is project-level and the test projects are little-known and recent to limit memorization. Known exception: test project snkv vendors the training project sqlite (217 of 2,000 fixed test rows). Each row keeps the license of the C project it was compiled from; only permissively licensed projects (MIT, BSD, ISC, zlib, Apache-2.0, public domain) are included.
